acceptance.given: Dependency resolution is invoked with an explicit set of supplied local dependency records.

oracle.expected: The structured resolution result and evaluation trace show that only the supplied local records were consulted.
forbidden: Dependencies are resolved by scanning all repositories.
A latest-successful log is selected as the dependency source.
The standard becomes a knowledge-query workflow.
oracle.observable: The dependency-resolution result records the selected supplied local records and the evaluation confirms no repository-wide scan, latest-successful log lookup, knowledge-base publication, or knowledge-query workflow occurred.

acceptance.then: Dependency resolution is bounded to the explicit supplied local records and exhibits none of the prohibited workflow behaviors.
acceptance.when: During dependency-resolution evaluation, inspect the structured result and source-selection/call boundary.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the focused dependency-boundary pytest selector against explicit local records; the assertion fails if resolution consults any repository-wide source, latest-successful log, knowledge publication path, or knowledge-query workflow.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Implement dependency resolution using only explicitly supplied local records and expose an observable result or trace for that boundary.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration; rollback removes the new validator dependency-resolution behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Dependency resolution changes from unspecified behavior to explicit-local-record resolution with prohibited workflow sources rejected.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The focused pytest selector passes only when the validator resolves exclusively from supplied local records and all four prohibited behaviors are absent.
